kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
أحرنجم (form IIIq)
# أَحْرَنْجِمُ (ʔaḥranjimu) /ʔaħ.ran.d͡ʒi.mu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِحْرَنْجَمَ (iḥranjama)
# أَحْرَنْجِمَ (ʔaḥranjima) /ʔaħ.ran.d͡ʒi.ma/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِحْرَنْجَمَ (iḥranjama)
# أَحْرَنْجِمْ (ʔaḥranjim) /ʔaħ.ran.d͡ʒim/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِحْرَنْجَمَ (iḥranjama)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
